intro: Greece is the home of the Olympic Games, and modern Greeks love football and basketball.

chapters.title: Home of the Olympics
text: The first modern Olympics were held in Athens in 1896, and the Olympic flame is still lit at Olympia before every Games. The marathon is named after the legend of a messenger who ran from Marathon to Athens. Long jumper Miltiadis Tentoglou won Olympic gold in 2021 and 2024.

chapters.title: Football and basketball
text: In 2004 Greece shocked the world by winning the European Championship. Basketball is hugely popular, and Giannis Antetokounmpo, who grew up in Athens, won the NBA title in 2021.
